setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json (admin) and profile.<seller>.json (a non-admin seller). Deal stages for won and lost deals. A saved Deal filter <private filter> created by the admin and not shared.

evals.prompt: Crea un filtro guardado en negocios que se llame '<filter name>' con mis negocios abiertos de este mes, y compártelo con el equipo.
evals.expected_output: Previews a filter plan (assignee $me, stage not won/lost, thisMonth, shared), explains that 'mis' becomes the creator's id and the month is fixed, stops; after the yes applies and reads back.
expectations: Runs scripts/ui.js preview with kind filter; never a hand-made POST
Tells the user that everyone will see the creator's deals (not their own) and that the dates do not move to next month
Writes nothing before the yes; after it runs apply with --version and --confirmed

evals.prompt: ¿Por qué el vendedor <seller> no ve el filtro <private filter>?
evals.expected_output: Reads the filter as admin and as the seller (--profile), explains it is not shared, offers a share plan; writes nothing.
expectations: Uses filter or filters with --profile for the seller
Says the cause is that the filter is not shared (only its creator and admins see it)

evals.prompt: Pon por defecto las columnas nombre, etapa, valor y asesor en la lista de negocios.
evals.expected_output: Maps the words to Deal fields (dealName, stage, proposal.quote, assignee), previews a columns plan, says users with their own columns keep them until Restablecer, stops.
expectations: Runs fields or reads the schema before choosing paths; no invented field like 'valor'
Previews kind columns and reports whether it updates an existing default

evals.prompt: Agrega una acción en la fila de contactos que abra http://<site>/buscar?correo= con el correo del contacto, para todos.
evals.expected_output: Uses openUrl with {{email}}, requires https, shows the host, that the e-mail leaves Prolibu and that every user gets the button; stops.
expectations: Does not save an http:// link; asks for or proposes https
Shows opens (host), dataSentOut (email) and that all users get it
Writes nothing in the first turn

evals.prompt: Quita el widget que pusieron en el campo <field> de negocios.
evals.expected_output: Lists CustomUi for Deal, finds the widget on that field, previews a deactivate plan (never delete), stops.
expectations: Runs ui with --model Deal (and --type) to find it
Previews kind deactivate; never a DELETE
